entities.name: Finroy
entities.description: Man from Tyarel during the Ice Age who studied history in Jornstad and impersonated Lord Rothchild.

entities.name: Lord Rothchild
entities.description: Popular regent of Jornstad, a drunken lecher.

entities.name: Sir Udo
entities.description: Knight Finroy jousted against while posing as Rothchild.

entities.name: Rhindle
entities.description: Scaled wurm hunted by Finroy posing as Rothchild.

events.summary: Finroy goes to Jornstad to study history and takes employment with Lord Rothchild.
events.quote: When Finroy was eighteen, he traveled to Jornstad to study history.

events.summary: Finroy impersonates Rothchild in armor, jousting against Sir Udo and suffering a lance blow.
events.quote: The first involved jousting against Sir Udo , which resulted in a lance blow to the chest that required Finroy to receive healing afterward.

events.summary: Finroy poses as Rothchild on a hunt against the wurm Rhindle and breaks his thigh.
events.quote: The second was on a hunt against the scaled wurm Rhindle , which resulted in Finroy receiving a broken thigh.

relations.quote: he eventually came under the employ of the popular regent, Lord Rothchild
